lines.en: After 10 questions, nothing left to do.
Guess if an apartment name is real.

lines.ko: 이제 들어가자마자 끝없이 풀 수 있습니다.
lines.en: Now you can play endlessly the moment you enter.
Questions keep coming while you're right.
The official match is the daily 10, only if you want it.
enLines: The official match is the daily 10,

lines.ko: 처음엔 10문제를 끝내야 더 풀 수 있었습니다.
lines.en: At first, you had to finish the 10 to keep playing.
enLines: At first, you had to finish

lines.ko: 지금은 휴대폰이 보낸 점수를 그대로 받습니다.
lines.en: Right now, I accept whatever score the phone sends.

lines.ko: 점수를 부풀려 보내도 알 수 없습니다.
lines.en: An inflated score would get through.
Next, the server that runs the site will check it.
lines.art: a referee checking a scorecard with a magnifying glass
